subject: Silverline billing release pattern and purchase-header mapping
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@silverline-corp.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@silverline-corp.com
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Purchasing constraints and billing cadence for Redwood pilot

Hi Sean,

Quick intro — I'm Olivia, procurement lead for Silverline Corp. We're close to finalizing the purchasing setup for the Redwood pilot (covering our AI platform and a small subset of inference calls). Before legal/ops cut the POs we need a quick confirmation on a few procurement-driven constraints so our AP team can map invoices into the ledger cleanly.

Our requirements:
- Purchase orders: we'll issue up to two POs per quarter for the pilot. Each PO will include our BU code, legal entity name, Silverline tax ID, and cost center.
- Invoice/statement cadence: we require consolidated monthly statements (one statement for the month) with invoice-level detail; statement to be provided by the 5th business day of the following month.
- Payment terms: standard for us is NET-45 from invoice receipt.
- Discounting: eligibility for volume-based discounts needs to be applied at the invoice level and visible on the monthly statement; discounts should be pro-rated if an invoice covers multiple POs or periods.
- Metadata: we need a vendor ledger ID on every invoice and the ability to pass two additional invoice fields: "billing_region" and "service_tag" for internal mapping.

I've attached a sample PO header (silverline_po_header_example.pdf) and our payment_terms_matrix.xlsx to show how AP expects file/field structure.

Can Redwood confirm:
1) Whether you can include the vendor ledger ID and the two metadata fields on every invoice;
2) Whether discounts will be pro-rated per invoice and reflected on the monthly statement (not just applied at payment time);
3) If NET-45 is acceptable vs. your standard terms.

If we can get this nailed down this week we'll have Procurement issue the first PO.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Procurement Lead, Silverline Corp
olivia.turner@silverline-corp.com

Attachments: silverline_po_header_example.pdf (stub), payment_terms_matrix.xlsx (stub)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@silverline-corp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Purchasing constraints and billing cadence for Redwood pilot

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear note and the sample. Looping in Ben from finance so we can confirm the invoice schema and discount mechanics.

Short answers up front: we can meet most of these requirements, but a couple clarifications before I confirm formally:

- Vendor ledger ID + metadata: we can include a vendor_ledger_id field on every invoice and add two free-form invoice metadata fields. Can you confirm the exact field names you want us to consume (you mentioned "billing_region" and "service_tag").
- Consolidated monthly statement: we can deliver a single consolidated statement per month and commit to delivering it by the 3rd business day following month end (we typically produce by the 3rd; sounds like you want by the 5th which is fine).
- Discounts: we support invoice-level discounting and can pro-rate if an invoice covers multiple POs. We need to clear whether the discount trigger is based on invoice date or payment date (important for early-pay discounts).
- Payment terms: our standard is NET-30, but Finance is open to NET-45 for enterprise pilots with PO commitments. Ben — can you confirm whether we can accept NET-45 for Silverline under proposal SL-7892 and how that impacts the discount flow?

Next steps: if you confirm the two metadata field exact names and whether discounts should be tied to invoice date, we'll draft a short PO amendment to lock in NET-45 and the invoice schema. I'll attach our statement template for your AP to validate.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.ai

Attachment: redwood_statement_template.pdf (stub)

Thanks Sean — answers inline below. Quoted for context.

> - Vendor ledger ID + metadata: we can include a vendor_ledger_id field on every invoice and add two free-form invoice metadata fields. Can you confirm the exact field names you want us to consume (you mentioned "billing_region" and "service_tag").

Confirmed: please use billing_region and service_tag exactly as written. Vendor ledger ID will be "SL_VENDOR_ID" in our ERP.

> - Discounts: we support invoice-level discounting and can pro-rate if an invoice covers multiple POs. We need to clear whether the discount trigger is based on invoice date or payment date (important for early-pay discounts).

Discount trigger: invoice date. If payment arrives within an early-pay window, AP will record that in the payment file, but for our ledger we need the discount to appear on the invoice/stub (so reconciliation is easier).

> - Payment terms: our standard is NET-30, but Finance is open to NET-45 for enterprise pilots with PO commitments. Ben — can you confirm whether we can accept NET-45 for Silverline under proposal SL-7892 and how that impacts the discount flow?

We will proceed with NET-45. If Redwood wants to offer an early-pay discount (e.g., 2% if paid within 15 days), we can accept that as long as the discount is shown on the invoice and included on the monthly statement.

Attached is a slightly updated PO header example with a comment on the vendor ledger field and a sample mapping for our ERP.

Let me know if there are any blockers. We'd like Procurement to issue PO #SL-2027-07-01 once we have written confirmation on NET-45 and the invoice metadata.

Regards,
Olivia

Attachments: silverline_po_header_example_v2.pdf (stub)

Olivia / Sean — Ben from Finance here. Thanks for the clear spec, Olivia. We discussed internally and can confirm the following for SL-7892: 

1) NET-45 acceptance: Redwood Finance will accept NET-45 for the pilot scope outlined. We'll reflect invoice receipt date as the term anchor.

2) Vendor ledger + metadata: we'll include a vendor_ledger_id (we will map your "SL_VENDOR_ID" into our accounting reference), billing_region, and service_tag fields on every invoice. We'll supply an invoice-level JSON payload attached to the PDF that matches your header mapping.

3) Discounts: we will apply discounts at the invoice level and those discounts will be visible on the monthly consolidated statement. For invoices that span multiple POs or periods, discounts will be pro-rated across line items and the pro-rate math will be included in the statement appendix. Important: per Silverline request, discounts will be recorded against invoice date (per your AP rules).

4) Statement cadence: Redwood will deliver the consolidated monthly statement by the 3rd business day following month-end. We'll include invoice-level metadata and a reconciliation appendix that shows PO -> invoice mapping.

Action items / mutual action plan:
- Olivia / Silverline: issue PO #SL-2027-07-01 and the second PO when available; attach the exact PO header sample you expect.
- Redwood (Ben): circulate final invoice schema (JSON + PDF sample) by EOD Monday 7/5.
- Redwood (Sean): prepare a short amendment (one-page) to the SOW to capture NET-45 and the invoice metadata requirements for signature.

If that looks right I'll mark SL-7892 as "Ready for PO" in our CRM and Sean can follow up with the amendment.

Best,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance (Sales Billing), Redwood Inference
